simple.meaning: בָּרַק (bâraq) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to lighten (lightning).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Psalms, beginning at Psalms 144:6. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בָּרַק (H1299) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: בָּרַק (bâraq) / H1299 is traced through Psalms 144:6 with source-language evidence and verse context.
